relationships.evidence_quote: It has also been postulated that CBD increases brain-derived neurotropic factor (BDNF), thereby reducing depression [43].

relationships.subject: CBD
relationships.evidence_quote: CBD, by way of the TRPV-1 receptor, was able to reduce the levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines (eotaxin1, IL-2, IL-6, IL-12, IL-17, TNF-α, IFC-c, and MCP-1) [89]

relationships.subject: GPR55
relationships.evidence_quote: in a murine model, the GPR55 receptor modulates the proinflammatory cytokines IL-4, IL-10, IFN gamma, and GM-CSF, thereby mitigating hyperalgesia

key_findings: Review of the endocannabinoid system (CB1, CB2, TRPV1, PPARs, AEA, 2-AG) as a therapeutic target in anxiety, pain, inflammation and other diseases.
Cannabinoids are proposed as opioid-sparing analgesic adjuvants; CBD analgesia linked to reduced inflammation and neuronal excitability.
